goal: Complete macOS UI tasks through the native Neo Computer Use CLI using fresh state and verification

cases.prompt: Find Finder and click a named UI element in its current window.
expected: neo computer-use help or known command

cases.prompt: A previous click failed because the element index is stale; continue.
expected: avoid reusing old state_id or element_index

cases.prompt: Navigate an already signed-in managed Chrome website and complete a form.
expected: do not open a duplicate unmanaged browser

cases.prompt: Try to use neo mcp call shell or setup, or run an unexpected Computer Use subcommand.
expected: generic Neo.app MCP tools are not callable via CLI
only approved neo computer-use subcommands are supported
use local Shell for other operations

cases.prompt: A Neo.app Computer Use call returns isError true because permission is missing.
expected: do not claim UI action completed
